blocks.text: Exercises: sentences from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR) and from the library's public-domain books.

exercises.q: ___ (весь июнь, acc. sg.) Коля не давал житья бедным влюбленным.
exercises.why: **июнь → июнь** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in -ь. Declines like DLI's автомобиль — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. автомобиль). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **весь → весь** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with июнь). «весь» is a pronoun-type word with its own declension, not the regular adjective pattern, so no ending rule is claimed. Its forms (m. sg.): весь · всего · всему · весь (inan.) / всего (anim.) · всем · всём.  Declension: sg. июнь · июня · июню · июнь · июнем · июне; pl. июни · июней · июням · июни · июнями · июнях.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Да; но он только в ___ (последний месяц, acc. sg.) стал совсем забываться.
exercises.why: **месяц → месяц** (acc. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. дом). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  **последний → последний** (acc. sg. m., agreeing with месяц). Adjective type II, soft — declines like DLI's синий (every form has the same endings): A. anim. = G., inan. = N. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. месяц · месяца · месяцу · месяц · месяцем · месяце; pl. месяцы · месяцев · месяцам · месяцы · месяцами · месяцах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Но почти несомненно «на ___ (утро, acc. sg.)».
exercises.why: **утро → утро** (acc. sg.). Neuter, nominative singular in -о. Declines like DLI's окно — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. окно). No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. утро · утра · утру · утро · утром · утре; pl. утра · утр · утрам · утра · утрами · утрах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Муки окончились через ___ (сутки, acc. pl.).
exercises.why: **сутки → сутки** (acc. pl.). A plural-only noun (it has no singular); nominative plural сутки. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension (plural only): сутки · суток · суткам · сутки · сутками · сутках.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  «The letter ы never follows г, к, х, ж, ч, ш, щ; therefore: книга — книги, река — реки, госпожа — госпожи.» — DLI, Lesson 23.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

Declension: sg. ужин · ужина · ужину · ужин · ужином · ужине; pl. ужины · ужинов · ужинам · ужины · ужинами · ужинах.  «The accusative of masculine animate nouns is the same as the genitive. The accusative of masculine inanimate nouns and of all neuter nouns is the same as the nominative.» — DLI, Lesson 32.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Слушайте, вам в визе отказали три ___ (месяц, gen. sg.) назад?
exercises.why: **месяц → месяца** (gen. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (G. sg. дома). Ending — (no ending) → -а.  Declension: sg. месяц · месяца · месяцу · месяц · месяцем · месяце; pl. месяцы · месяцев · месяцам · месяцы · месяцами · месяцах.  Genitive endings: masculine -а, -я (книга студента, книга учителя); neuter -а, -я (стакан вина, часть здания); feminine -ы, -и (стакан воды, часть семьи, часть тетради). — DLI, Lesson 23.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: ___ (целый вечер, acc. pl.) Даша играла на рояле.
exercises.why: **вечер → вечера** (acc. pl.). Masculine, inanimate; nominative plural вечера. Declines like DLI's дом — every plural form has the same endings (A. pl. дома). Ending — (no ending) → -а.  **целый → целые** (acc. pl., agreeing with вечера). Adjective type I, hard — declines like DLI's новый (every form has the same endings): A. anim. = G., inan. = N. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. вечер · вечера · вечеру · вечер · вечером · вечере; pl. вечера · вечеров · вечерам · вечера · вечерами · вечерах.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Notice that the adjectives of the "soft", "guttural" and "sibilant" types are declined in the plural in the very same way.» — DLI, Lesson 48.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Разве в ___ (такая минута, acc. pl.) о чем-либо думают?
exercises.why: **минута → минуты** (acc. pl.). Feminine, inanimate; nominative plural минуты. Declines like DLI's газета — every plural form has the same endings (A. pl. газеты). Ending -а → -ы.  **такой → такие** (acc. pl., agreeing with минуты). Adjective type III, guttural (after г, к, х) — declines like DLI's русский (every form has the same endings, apart from the masculine nominative singular (and the inanimate accusative equal to it), which ends in -ой here, not -ий): A. anim. = G., inan. = N. No change of ending: here the accusative is the same as the nominative.  Declension: sg. минута · минуты · минуте · минуту · минутой · минуте; pl. минуты · минут · минутам · минуты · минутами · минутах.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Masculine adjectives of the "hard" and "guttural" types have in the nominative the ending -ой if stressed: новый — молодой; русский — плохой, and retain the stress on the ending throughout the declension.» «The adjective «большой» belongs to the guttural type, in spite of its -ш-: большого, большому, большим, о большом.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  «Notice that the adjectives of the "soft", "guttural" and "sibilant" types are declined in the plural in the very same way.» — DLI, Lesson 48.  Adjectives in the accusative: animate = genitive, inanimate = nominative (masculine and plural); feminine -ую, -юю. — DLI, Lessons 46–47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Кирьяк был нездоров, задержался дома еще на ___ (неделя, acc. sg.).
exercises.why: **неделя → неделю** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -я. Declines like DLI's неделя — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. неделю). Ending -я → -ю.  Declension: sg. неделя · недели · неделе · неделю · неделей · неделе; pl. недели · недель · неделям · недели · неделями · неделях.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

The accusative singular of all other feminine nouns ends in -у or -ю.» — DLI, Lesson 33.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Три ___ (час, gen. sg.) назад.
exercises.why: **час → часа** (gen. sg.). Masculine, inanimate, nominative singular in a consonant. Declines like DLI's дом — every singular form has the same endings (G. sg. дома). Ending — (no ending) → -а.  Declension: sg. час · часа · часу · час · часом · часе; pl. часы · часов · часам · часы · часами · часах.  Genitive endings: masculine -а, -я (книга студента, книга учителя); neuter -а, -я (стакан вина, часть здания); feminine -ы, -и (стакан воды, часть семьи, часть тетради). — DLI, Lesson 23.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Всего ___ (неделя, acc. sg.) как его лошадь задавила, мальчишку-то!
exercises.why: **неделя → неделю** (acc. sg.). Feminine, nominative singular in -я. Declines like DLI's неделя — every singular form has the same endings (A. sg. неделю). Ending -я → -ю.  Declension: sg. неделя · недели · неделе · неделю · неделей · неделе; pl. недели · недель · неделям · недели · неделями · неделях.  «The accusative singular of all feminine nouns ending in -ь is the same as nominative. exercises.q: Знаете ли вы, какую муку я испытываю в ___ (этот день, acc. pl.)?
exercises.why: **день → дни** (acc. pl.). Masculine, inanimate; nominative plural дни. Declines like DLI's автомобиль — every plural form has the same endings (A. pl. автомобили). Ending -ь → -и, with the fleeting -е- of the stem dropped: дн- + -и.  **этот → эти** (acc. pl., agreeing with дни). «этот» is a pronoun-type word with its own declension, not the regular adjective pattern, so no ending rule is claimed. Its forms (pl.): эти · этих · этим · эти (inan.) / этих (anim.) · этими · этих.  Declension: sg. день · дня · дню · день · днём · дне; pl. дни · дней · дням · дни · днями · днях.  «The accusative plural of inanimate nouns is the same as the nominative plural. The accusative plural of animate nouns is the same as the genitive plural.» — DLI, Lesson 42.  «All adjectives agree in gender, number and case with the noun they modify.» — DLI, Lesson 47.  — Model words and rules from the DLI Grammar Reference Book; forms from the OpenCorpora dictionary (CC BY-SA 4.0).

exercises.q: Вот кто — манапы помогают нам в ___ (тяжёлая минута, acc. sg.) жизни.
